d:
Yes... it's another AI story, and I know it's not a masterpiece. But I'm happy to have finally brought it to life. If you're not a fan of AI, know that I didn't make this for you. Don't waste your time commenting that "it's horrible," "AI is garbage," "I could have done better," etc. This story wasn't made to please everyone, but rather as a project that's been in my head for a long time.

Now, for those who want to read it, feel free! I accept criticism, as long as it's respectful. It's the first story I've written; I'm just one person and I learned a lot while working on it. I intend to improve, and constructive criticism helps me in that process. I hope you enjoy it!
